newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dow and bonds to lead post-budget Belgian shares.
newsitem.headline: Dow and bonds to lead post-budget Belgian shares.

text.p: A flat or weaker local bond market and the Dow Jones will set the tone for Belgian shares, dealers said Tuesday.
"I think we'll perform in line with the Dow and there's no upside left in bonds," said a dealer. "The bond market might even punish today's budget a little bit."
The Bel-20 index .BFX closed Tuesday up 7.93 points or 0.45 percent at 1,779.16 following release of the 1997 Budget.
"The budget had no impact on the market," said a trader. "Belgian bonds followed Bunds and there was no difference in the spread with Bunds despite the budget."

Retailers Delhaize and Colruyt gained 1.7 and 2.6 percent respectively. Dealers attributed Delhaize's strength, in high volume of nearly 140,000 shares, to the good performance of Food Lion in the U.S.

Tractebel was the biggest volume by value, ending up 0.2 percent at 14,675 francs. "Small retail clients are taking profits and leaving," said a trader. "Professionals are buying for the free put warrant."
